## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible problem and what changes. Link an issue when relevant.

## Validation

List commands run and their results. For a new rule, include valid and invalid
fixtures, rule ID, severity, applicability and remediation.

## Compatibility and documentation

- [ ] Existing CLI exit codes and schema field types are preserved, or changes are explained.
- [ ] Documentation/changelog updated where needed.
- [ ] Fixtures have clear provenance and redistribution rights; no secrets or private data are included.
- [ ] Relevant tests and required checks pass (or failures are explained).
